audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Level 6 to Skill and 2+ items to Yorick, while the page's own whys say the 6 all-in is yours and that Kassadin 'outscales you completely' late. The packet chart also reads Yorick at 6 and Kassadin at 2+ items.
audit.why: Yorick's only ultimate spike lands at 6 against a Kassadin whose Riftwalk is still 5s and 40 mana; by two items Riftwalk is 2s at rank 3 and a swarm that walks on foot cannot follow a blink. The mirror audit's own late-game text says Kassadin 1v9s teamfights at 2+ items, so both sides agree.
audit.corrected: win[4]/phases[4].side to Yorick (rating 7/10), win[6]/phases[6].side to Kassadin (rating 3/10). Rows 0-3 stay Yorick, matching the mirror's pre-6 thesis.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[0..3] called levels 1-5 'even' and 'skill-based' while every other line on the page says to bully him pre-6, and the rows said Yorick.
audit.why: Kassadin pre-6 has one 650-range Null Sphere and no wave clear; Mourning Mist is 700 range and shreds armour as it marks, so Yorick pokes from outside the enemy's only spell. Kassadin's spikes are Riftwalk at 6 and item scaling; Yorick's are levels 2-3, Maiden at 6 and first item.
audit.corrected: Rewrote whys[0..3] to state the early lead, and phases[4].why / phases[6].why to the real 6 and 2-item spikes.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere, Riftwalk described only as 'his mobility spike at 6', and the page never said Riftwalk blinks over Dark Procession or that Nether Blade is an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: Riftwalk is 5/3.5/2s at 500 range and is a blink — it ignores the destructible wall, so the cage must be placed on the ground he lands on, not where he stands. Nether Blade is a 7s auto-reset, so his burst arrives on an attack wind-up rather than a visible cast. Force Pulse is a 400-range cone on 21s at rank 1. Null Sphere's shield absorbs magic damage only, per Riot's text.
audit.corrected: Riftwalk / Nether Blade / Force Pulse numbers into breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d; the Riftwalk-over-cage and magic-only-shield facts into report[5].t.
